mentions.name: KPBJ LPFM community radio station
mentions.description: A low-power FM community radio station in Los Angeles being developed toward a full broadcast operation. It has accumulated nearly all equipment needed for the FM broadcast (an EAS decoder is still needed), is building out its studio space including welded booth tables and a vintage Orban Optimod for the airchain, and hosts a growing roster of over 80 shows.
mentions.audience: People in Los Angeles and anyone who loves community radio
mentions.source_excerpt:
Continuing to develop my LPFM radio station www.kpbj.fm

- We have accumulated almost all the equipment needed to setup our FM broadcast. The main piece of equipment we still need is the EAS Decoder.

- Our studio space build is in progress. I recently welded some tables for the booth and found an old Orban Optimod for our airchain.

- We have over 80 shows and our roster continues to grow.

If you are in Los Angeles or love community radio please reach out.
mentions.author: solomonb
